title: Phase — Task (minimal flat)
description: Two flat approve boundaries: (1) context + PLAN.md + validate_plan + user approval; (2) implement with fetch_knowhow + inline two-layer review + tests + verify_compliance. Same MCP/skills as compact paths, fewer step/approve cycles — weaker per-slice audit trail.

steps.title: Plan, validate, approve

skill_candidates.when: After PLAN.md exists: run validate_plan, present MCP output, then apply the approval criteria from this skill before asking the user to sign off (same combined gate as phase.review.compact step validate_approve).

steps.notes: Primary: draft PLAN.md per write-plan (get_task_context when applicable, traceability, Won't do / Later). Then validate_plan(PLAN.md) and use plan-approval criteria for the human gate. No production code in this step. If plan changes → update PLAN.md and validate again.

steps.title: Implement, review, test, compliance
steps.notes: Per PLAN: fetch_knowhow(domain) before each domain slice; Red–Green–Refactor; small commits. Include a single two-layer review pass (AC + quality) before calling tests green; then verify_compliance. On wrong requirement → return to Plan step via reject/new session per team policy.
